title: Japanese Stir-Fried Cabbage
description: A quick and delicious Japanese-inspired stir-fry made with cabbage, savory seasonings, and a hint of sweetness.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of sesame oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the grated ginger and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add the sliced cabbage and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes, or until it begins to soften.
Add the stir-fry sauce, soy sauce, and sugar. Stir-fry for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the cabbage is tender.
Serve hot, garnished with sesame seeds if desired.
